issues.description: Tab key path bypasses item validity check, may insert empty/invalid completion
issues.detail: The new early-return runs before the `if item is None: item = self.item(0)` guard. When `use_enter_for_completions` is False and Tab is pressed, the original flow still applies, but for any other key it short-circuits to `self.textedit.keyPressEvent(event)` without considering whether a completion was actually selectable. Edge cases (e.g., empty list) should be considered.

issues.description: Enter still triggers default keyPressEvent which may insert a newline plus other side effects
issues.detail: When disabled, pressing Enter forwards the event to `self.textedit.keyPressEvent(event)` after `self.hide()`. This means Enter inserts a newline in the editor — likely intended — but Escape, arrows, and every other non-Tab key now also dismiss the popup and forward to the editor, which may break navigation within the completion list (Up/Down/PageUp/PageDown) that previously stayed in the popup.

issues.description: Condition includes Tab but excludes Shift+Tab and other modified Tab variants
issues.detail: `not key == Qt.Key_Tab` only special-cases the bare Tab key. If users press Shift+Tab (Backtab maps to Qt.Key_Backtab) for reverse navigation, the popup will hide and forward the event. Confirm intended behavior; if Tab-family keys should accept, check Qt.Key_Backtab as well.

issues.description: Operator precedence is correct but readability suffers from `not key == Qt.Key_Tab`
issues.detail: Prefer `key != Qt.Key_Tab` for clarity. The mixed `not ... and not key == ...` is harder to parse than `not <conf> and key != Qt.Key_Tab`. Minor style nit.

issues.description: No config version bump for new default key
issues.detail: Adding `use_enter_for_completions` to the completions section default config typically requires bumping `CONF_VERSION` in spyder/config/main.py so existing user configs pick up the new default rather than silently missing the key. Verify whether `get_conf` will return the default for users with stale configs.

issues.description: No tests added for the new disable-Enter behavior
issues.detail: Spyder has editor/completion tests; adding a focused test that toggles `use_enter_for_completions` to False and verifies Enter does not accept but Tab does would prevent regression. The change is small but user-visible.

review.summary: The PR adds a useful preference to disable Enter accepting completions, with config default, a checkbox on the completions page, and a guard in the popup's keyPressEvent. The main concerns are correctness around the keyPressEvent short-circuit: it bypasses the existing `item is None` fallback, treats every non-Tab key (including arrows and Shift+Tab/Backtab) as a dismiss-and-forward, which may degrade popup navigation. A config version bump and a small regression test would also harden the change.
